name: TickerK8 PRE ALPHA 0.0.4.0
body:
New Update Overview

This update introduces significant improvements in performance, structure, and usability.

Changes and Improvements:

The installation script has been fixed, simplified, and made more reliable.

The application’s visual design has been updated.

The update-related application code has been fully refactored, including a change in the object creation approach.

The previous file-based structure (__00__main.py, __01__setobjectname, etc.) has been replaced with a clearer and more maintainable architecture: structure, ui, and logic.

Objects are now created only when needed instead of all at once, resulting in improved performance.

File size has been reduced from 480 KiB to 244 KiB.

RAM usage has been reduced from 330 MB to 280 MB.

This update improves maintainability, efficiency, and overall application performance.
